answers.question: 135/04 Q1 · Suppose an example you agreed to in discovery goes missing from a story's contract, for instance because an agent deleted the scenario that carried it. Should building that story be refused until the example is restored (unanswered questions already work that way), or should the doctor only report it? Refusing means the build can't start on a contract that lost something you agreed. Reporting only means the build goes ahead and the gap shows as a red doctor finding at review.
